text.text_excerpt: We went to the grand opening. I had the Cafe Au Late...fresh brewed coffee & cream with chocolate covered coffee beans...omg! So yummy! The whole texture of the beans with the cold of the ice cream is so good. I also placed and order of fried pickles. It was a long wait for my order but was well worth it. My friend had the Vegan very very berry and she enjoyed it. The young lady that did my ice cream was very friendly. There is only 6 tables so seating is very limited. One less star was for when the owner or manager walked to every table to acknowledge their customers, he totally skip my table. Even the cashier was walking around to ask if anything was ok and he also didn't even stopped a...

This is a fun little place to go for a unique ice cream experience. I'd heard of rolled ice cream before but never got around to trying it until I went here the other day. It's located on Jefferson in a not so highly advertised shopping center. I wouldn't have noticed it if I was just passing by (the only reason I found it is because I was looking up ice cream shops in the area). I got the Cinnamon Toast Crunch one-I'm pretty basic so all I got was the Cinnamon Toast Crunch as a topping mixed into their cream. I thought it was pretty neat that they have a large list of additional toppings you can add for no additional cost, though. The rollers were really nice and it was cool watching the...

Delicious! Very friendly service! If you go during peak hours it may take 10-15 minutes to get your order due to the time it takes to make rolled ice cream, but they have multiple stations and it moves pretty fast. Had the kids size and was plenty for me. The flavors are awesome, I highly recommend the Nutella flavor! Will be coming back often.
